tools.name: check_hours
tools.description: Check a list of logged service/volunteer hours for internal consistency: bad dates, non-positive or impossible day totals, missing organization, and days above this service's 8-hour flag. Deterministic arithmetic only - no AI. It does NOT decide whether the hours satisfy any school or award requirem

tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: The exact rule table this service checks against, with the reason each rule is checkable, plus what it explicitly does not claim. Quote it if you need to explain a result.

tools.name: create_record
tools.description: Open an hour ledger for one student (returns a record id). Requires a bearer key.

tools.name: add_entries
tools.description: Append logged hours to an existing record. Requires a bearer key.

tools.name: get_record_summary
tools.description: Totals, per-category breakdown, and every issue found, for one record. Requires a bearer key.

tools.name: request_signoff
tools.description: Create a one-time URL a supervisor can open to confirm the recorded hours. Requires a bearer key. The token is single use.
